visual_style: Graphic illustration style, reminiscent of Pop Art or vintage concert posters. Highly stylized, emphasizing bold lines and defined color blocks.
lighting: Dramatic and theatrical, using harsh contrasts and implied graphic shadows rather than soft gradients. Spotlight effect.
background_style: Abstract geometric color blocking. The background is constructed from intersecting, solid-colored planes and diagonal lines, creating a layered, structured feel.
composition_style: Dynamic and angular. Uses strong diagonals and framing elements created by the background shapes to guide the eye and structure the overall portrait.
texture: Flat and uniform (Solid Color). No discernible photographic texture; the rendering is completely graphic.
medium: Vector illustration / Screen print effect (Pop Art Print)
